title: Stadium Daybreak
author: Freek van Gool
description: A dancefloor drum and bass track in A minor at 174 BPM, 128 bars (about 2 minutes 57): tight two-step drums with ghost snares and snare-roll builds, a clean sub under a distorted mid bass, a supersaw hook over Am, F, C and G, pumping chord pads ducked by the kick, vocal chops, risers and impacts. Intro, build, drop 1, break, build 2, drop 2 with an extra harmony layer, and outro. Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
